facts.business: Spencer's Retail Limited operates a food-first retail business across formats including Spencer's, Natures Basket, and Jiffy quick commerce, offering staples, fresh produce, processed food, beverages, and omnichannel fulfilment.

segments.name: Food and grocery retail (Spencer's, Natures Basket, Jiffy)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern: The Company has incurred a loss of Rs 13,359.87 lakhs and has net current liabilities of Rs. 64,721.61 lakhs. Borrowings of Rs. 99,210.13 lakhs against total equity of Rs. (42,899.44) lakhs. Management's assessment of going concern involves judgement and estimation of key variables and market conditions.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and negative net worth
High leverage with borrowings of Rs 99,210.13 lakhs against negative equity
Dependence on promoter support and continued credit facilities
Short-term funds of Rs 46,144.84 lakhs used for long-term purposes
Cash losses of Rs 7,735.18 lakhs in current year and Rs 7,897.15 lakhs in previous year
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards. Borrowings include related party borrowings of Rs 99,210.13 lakhs. Additional securities provided by associate companies for availing facilities from banks/financial institutions.
